subject: linear_algebra
goal: Solve the system completely, classify its solution set and check the result in both original equations.
domain: x and y are real. Columns are x coefficient, y coefficient, then right-hand constant. R1 and R2 denote complete rows. A is the coefficient matrix, [A|b] the augmented matrix, and S the solution set.

steps: Replace row 2 by row 2 minus twice row 1. Which complete destination row results?
Divide every entry of row 2 by its nonzero pivot -3. Which row results?
Clear y from row 1 by subtracting row 2. Which complete row results?
Read the reduced rows. Which ordered pair is the unique solution?
Substitute that pair into both ORIGINAL equations. What ordered values do their left sides take?

cases.coverage: signed y coefficient; positive elimination pivot
steps: Replace row 2 by row 2 minus three times row 1. Which complete row results?
Divide the complete second row by 7. Which row results?
Clear y from row 1 by adding twice row 2. Which row results?
Which ordered pair is fixed by the two pivot rows?
Evaluate both ORIGINAL left sides at that pair. Which ordered values result?

cases.coverage: initial row swap with zero first x coefficient
steps: Swap the two complete rows to put a nonzero x coefficient first. Which matrix results?
Divide every entry of row 2 by 3. Which row results?
Subtract twice row 2 from row 1 to clear y. Which row results?
Which ordered pair is the unique solution, in x,y order?
Check the pair in the ORIGINAL row order. Which left-side values result?
Subtract twice row 1 from row 2. Which complete destination row results?
Normalize row 2 by dividing all entries by -5. Which row results?
Subtract twice the normalized row 2 from row 1. Which row results?
Which exact ordered pair follows from the two pivot rows?
Substitute the exact fractions in the ORIGINAL equations. Which left-side values result?

cases.coverage: negative pivot; fractional multiplier; negative x
steps: Eliminate x from row 2 by adding three halves of row 1. Which whole row results?
Divide all entries of row 2 by seven halves. Which row results?
Subtract row 2 from row 1 to clear y. Which complete row results?
Normalize row 1 by dividing its complete equation by -2. Which row results?
Which exact ordered pair is fixed by the normalized rows?
Evaluate both ORIGINAL left sides, retaining exact fractions. Which values result?

cases.coverage: nonunit x pivot; negative y pivot; fractions
steps: Subtract twice row 1 from row 2. Which whole row results?
Normalize row 2 by dividing all three entries by -7. Which row results?
Subtract three times row 2 from row 1. Which row results?
Divide every entry of row 1 by 2. Which row results?
Which ordered pair solves the two pivot equations?
Check the pair against both ORIGINAL equations. Which ordered left-side values result?
Subtract twice row 1 from row 2, including the constant. Which row results?
Classify the system from coefficient rank and augmented rank. Which statement follows?
Compare twice ORIGINAL equation 1 with ORIGINAL equation 2; both now have left side 2x-4y. What ordered constants do they require?
Add one half of row 1 to row 2. Which complete row results?
Divide the retained first row by 2 to normalize its pivot. Which row results?
Let t be any real number and set the non-pivot variable y=t. Which expression describes ALL solutions?
Substitute the family into both ORIGINAL left sides. Which identities hold for every real t?

cases.coverage: method choice; zero first pivot; fractional swap solve
steps: A nonzero x pivot is needed first. Which move puts an existing equation first without rescaling or combining equations?
Normalize the second row by dividing all entries by 2. Which row results?
Add row 2 to row 1 to clear its y coefficient. Which row results?
Divide the complete first row by 3. Which row results?
Which exact ordered pair follows from the pivot rows?
Check both ORIGINAL equations in their original order. Which left-side values result?

cases.coverage: method choice; unit pivot without initial fractions
steps: Which first move gives row 1 a unit x pivot without introducing fractional entries?
Subtract twice row 1 from row 2. Which whole row results?
Divide every entry of row 2 by -11. Which row results?
Subtract four times row 2 from row 1. Which row results?
Which exact ordered pair is fixed by the two pivots?
Substitute into the ORIGINAL equations rather than the swapped order. Which left-side values result?

cases.coverage: zero x column does not imply consistency
steps: Normalize the first nonzero coefficient in row 1 by dividing the whole row by 2. Which row results?
Add six times row 1 to row 2 to clear y. Which whole row results?
Does the augmented row permit any solution? Select the coefficient-rank and augmented-rank conclusion.
Compare -3 times ORIGINAL equation 1 with ORIGINAL equation 2; both now have left side -6y. What ordered constants do they require?

cases.coverage: y pivot; x free; method and family completeness
steps: The x column is zero. Normalize the first nonzero coefficient of row 1 by dividing by -3. Which row results?
Subtract six times row 1 from row 2. Which complete row results?
Let t be any real number and set the non-pivot variable x=t. Which expression describes ALL solutions?
Substitute the family into both ORIGINAL left sides. Which identities hold for every real t?
